dashboard.label: Better Map - Overview
dashboard.description: Executive cross-domain showcase: top-row KPIs across all four domains (active threats, fleet on-road, sites OK, sensors alarming), two cinematic dark-matter maps side-by-side (3D-extruded incident hexbins on the left, pulsing global site markers on the right), and a bottom recent-events table. Both maps coordinate camera state through `better_map.camera.*` tokens so dragging one mirrors the other. Cyber palette, vignette, glow, 30\u00b0 cinematic pitch.
